exposure: ERAC protocol with multimodal pain control
cohort: The study included 100 women who underwent Cesarean section in 2020 (pre-ERAC protocol) and 100 women who underwent Cesarean section in 2022 (post-ERAC protocol implementation) at Henry Ford St. John Hospital.
finding: The ERAC protocol with multimodal pain control significantly decreased opioid usage (MME) on postoperative days 1 and 2, but did not show a significant difference in maternal pain scores.
